# Appwrite Blog

> Articles on Appwrite product updates, engineering, and developer guides.

Append `.md` to any blog post URL, or open the links below, to receive the raw Markdown source.

- [Announcing the S3 API: Use any S3 client with Appwrite Storage](https://appwrite.io/blog/post/announcing-s3-api.md): Appwrite Storage now exposes an S3-compatible API. Point the AWS CLI, the AWS SDKs, and tools like rclone at your Appwrite buckets, with no migration required.
